vendors.name: Munchies
vendors.summary: Roti wraps, toasties and hand-cut waffle fries — organic, coconut-oil-fried comfort food to fuel the dancefloor.
bio: Munchies brings roti wraps built around flame-grilled chicken or golden chickpea falafel, piled with fresh vegetables and finished with creamy tahini or shawarma sauce.
Alongside the wraps: fully-loaded toasties in combinations like bacon and egg, tomato and cheese, or bacon and cheese, plus organic hand-cut waffle fries fried in coconut oil.
Prices run from R10 to R120, with a chickpea falafel option for vegetarians.

vendors.name: Groove Gear
vendors.summary: A festival lifestyle lounge for LED and UV accessories, face and body gems, hair braiding, glow transformations and relaxing massage.
bio: Groove Gear is a festival lifestyle brand created from a love for music, creativity, self-expression and the festival community, bringing the magic of festivals to life through LED and UV accessories, festival fashion, face and body gems, festival makeup, hair braiding, creative glow transformations and relaxing festival massage experiences.
The Groove Gear Lounge offers festival-goers a space to express themselves, recharge, connect and add extra sparkle, colour and energy to their Earthdance experience.

vendors.name: Mushmore
vendors.summary: An adaptogen and nootropic wellness bar — mood-enhancing mocktails, functional mushroom coffees and social tonics.
bio: Mushmore is an adaptogen and nootropic wellness bar, serving mood-enhancing mocktails alongside functional mushroom coffees and lattes.

The lineup runs through adaptogen and nootropic canned beverages and a shelf of wellness brands — Almmy sparkling teas, Numuti social tonics, Vitafuel and Teelixir — with vegan, sugar-free options throughout.

vendors.name: Lekker Leaf Wellness
vendors.summary: Cannabis and wellness body goods — "where community grows one leaf at a time."
bio: Lekker Leaf Wellness brings cannabis alongside skincare and body wellness goods to the market village, most priced under R150.
Their tagline says it best: where community grows one leaf at a time.
vendors.logo_alt: Lekker Leaf Wellness logo — a cannabis leaf rising from waves inside a sun, beside the wordmark Lekker Leaf and the tagline Where community grows one leaf at a time

vendors.name: GeoVinty Clothing
vendors.summary: A celebration of sacred geometry, creativity and individuality — each garment upcycled with bleach into a unique piece of wearable art.
bio: GeoVinty Clothing is a celebration of sacred geometry, creativity and individuality. Each garment is upcycled with bleach into a unique piece of wearable art, made with love and positivity.

No two pieces are ever exactly the same, making every creation as individual as the person wearing it. Inspired by free-spirited expression and festival culture, GeoVinty is all about wearing something meaningful, sustainable and beautifully different.
Wear your vibe.

vendors.name: Chai'la
vendors.summary: A zero-proof bar of chai, Chinese tea and cacao, with dairy-free options.
bio: Chai'la serves a zero-proof bar built around chai tea, Chinese tea and cacao.
Dairy-free options are available across the menu.

vendors.name: Fresh Bean Coffee Company
vendors.summary: Espresso-based coffee, matcha, fresh juices and boba, plus milkshakes, slushes and dirty sodas.
bio: Fresh Bean Coffee Company's menu runs from espresso-based coffee and hot chocolate to freshly squeezed juices, milkshakes, slushes, dirty sodas and frezos.
Matcha and boba are on offer alongside the coffee.
vendors.logo_alt: Fresh Bean Coffee Co. logo — green and brown wordmark with a coffee bean and steam icon

vendors.name: Love Pizza
vendors.summary: A family-run wood-fired pizza institution at Cape Town festivals since 2009 — part of the Earthdance family for over a decade.
bio: Love Pizza has been bringing great pizza to Cape Town's best festivals and events since 2009. A family-run business by Lisa (foodie extraordinaire) and Prince (operator like no other), they've also been part of the Earthdance family of food vendors for well over a decade.

They make their own large pizza bases, use top-quality toppings and offer a delicious selection of classic, gourmet, vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options. Every pizza is cooked in their traditional wood-fired oven for that perfect crisp, flame-kissed crust and smoky flavour.

The menu runs from a classic Margherita through Hawaiian, Rosa (cherry tomato, feta and basil pesto), Daisy (chicken, feta and peppadews), Trio (bacon, feta and mushrooms), S.O.S (salami, olives and sundried tomatoes) and Carni (bacon, ham, chicken and salami). Every pizza is a large, built to satisfy a hungry festival-goer solo or split between friends.
Sharing is caring. Be nice, share a slice.

vendors.name: Oh So Peachy
vendors.summary: Delicious food and raw juices made with love — pancakes, samosas, cold-pressed juices and heartier plates.
bio: Oh So Peachy is a food trailer cafe serving pancakes (plain or filled), samosas, smoothies and raw juices, plus heartier plates like stir-fry, Thai curry and wraps.

The raw juice menu includes Green Machine (celery, cucumber, apple), Apple Home (apple, ginger, lemon), Beetroot Energy (beetroot, carrot, apple, ginger) and Golden Love (turmeric, apple, orange, lemon, ginger, cayenne pepper) — fresh ingredients, made with love, supporting local.

vendors.name: Atma
vendors.summary: Vegan and vegetarian food, coffees and smoothies, with a gluten-free option.
bio: Atma brings vegan and vegetarian food to the market village, alongside coffees and smoothies.
A gluten-free option is available.

vendors.name: Rosa Divina Adornment
vendors.summary: Jewellery and accessories, from small pieces to statement adornment.
bio: Rosa Divina Adornment brings jewellery and accessories to the market village, spanning a wide range from everyday pieces to statement adornment.

vendors.name: Chill and Charge
vendors.summary: A charging and chill-out space to power up your phone — and yourself — between sets.
bio: Chill and Charge offers a space to recharge both your devices and yourself between sets, with charging available by the half hour.

vendors.name: Wild & Woven
vendors.summary: For the wanderers, the wild ones, the barefoot dancers and the beautifully unconventional — 100% natural-fibre handmade clothing.
bio: For the wanderers, the wild ones, the barefoot dancers and the beautifully unconventional.

Wild & Woven brings 100% natural-fibre handmade clothing, with a love for earthy textures, relaxed fits, playful prints and pieces that are made to move with you — clothes for wherever the adventure takes you.

vendors.name: Blissful Wellness Escape
vendors.summary: Massage treatments, hair braiding and a glitter bar — a moment of calm between dancefloors.
bio: Blissful Wellness Escape offers massage treatments from quick express sessions to full 60–90 minute treatments, alongside hair braiding and a glitter bar.

vendors.name: Afrikan Crown
bio: Afrikan Crown brings Rasta-inspired clothing and accessories to the market village.

vendors.name: Firehawk Ink
vendors.summary: Tattoos — take a piece of Earthdance home under your skin.
bio: Firehawk Ink offers tattoos on site — a lasting way to mark the weekend.
